description: v2 simulation model contract: MuJoCo Menagerie trs_so_arm100 with the composed ACT->MuJoCo joint mapping.

act_to_mujoco.step_1: affine endpoint mapping from ACT dataset coordinates onto legacy_model_joint_low/high (the LeRobot-calibrated endpoints recorded in act_coordinate_contract.json, unchanged)

base_alignment.description: Pose of the patched model's Base body so the arm occupies the legacy world workspace. Derived by matching the shoulder_pan axis line (xy) and the shoulder_lift axis height (z); yaw resolves the OFFSET[0]=0 gauge.

derivation.method: chain-descent matching of physical invariants only (joint axis lines, next-joint axes, joint anchors, distal body centers of mass); body frames are export-arbitrary and were not compared. Offsets snapped to multiples of pi/2 when within 0.03 rad.

validation.note: COM residual reflects real SO-ARM100-v1.3-CAD vs SO-101-export geometry differences, not a convention error.

camera_site_transplant.description: wrist_camera, fixed_jaw_tip and moving_jaw_tip were FK-transplanted from the legacy model into the new gripper / moving jaw frames (runtime world poses; exact for plain frames). The wrist_camera_mount_visual MESH geom pose was instead derived by transforming the legacy XML's declared local pose through the rigid old-gripper -> new-gripper body transform, because MuJoCo's compiler folds a mesh re-centering transform into runtime geom poses and writing those back into XML applies the re-centering twice.

second_pose_verification.mount_cross_check: the same rigid-transform derivation reproduces the FK-transplanted camera pose to 7 decimal places

mujoco_joint_bounds.description: Clipping/safety envelope in Menagerie coordinates: converted calibrated endpoints (elementwise ordered) intersected with the Menagerie mechanical joint ranges.
